company.name: Wyvern
company.shortDescription: The highest resolution hyperspectral imagery of Earth from space.
company.description: Wyvern was created to unlock the secrets of the electromagnetic spectrum by providing groundbreaking access to high-resolution and quality imagery. The hyperspectral sensors on our Dragonette satellites will capture data in many narrow spectral bands, allowing for the identification of unique chemical and physical properties of the Earth's surface. This makes Wyvern's hyperspectral imagery data an extremely valuable tool for a wide range of site monitoring, mapping and geospatial intelligence (GEOINT) use-case applications.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $2,153,564, or 10.39% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $3,331,362, representing 16.07% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,872,777 to $79,136,274, a 20.43x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
